app.name: Tokyo Sanpo
boot.errorHint: Reload the page or open it in the latest Chrome or Edge.
boot.tip.1: Press C while walking to rise into the sky and look around.
boot.tip.2: Pass the ticket gates and press F at the stairs to reach the platform.
boot.tip.3: Use the map (M) to jump to places you have already visited.
boot.tip.4: In photo mode (P) you can change the time and exposure before shooting.
boot.tip.5: Get close to a landmark to record it in your field guide.
boot.tip.6: Call a share car with R or a share bike with B.
title.tagline: Walk, ride and fly through a Tokyo rebuilt from survey data
title.pickStart: Where would you like to start?
pause.title: Paused
settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityHint: Auto picks a tier for this PC on first run and steps down if it gets slow.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Turns off head bob, speed-based FOV widening and train sway.
settings.keyPress: Press a new key (Esc to cancel)
settings.keyConflict: {key} was moved here from another action
settings.padNote: Gamepads use the standard layout (X interact · Start pause · Ⓑ back).
settings.moveNote: Movement stays on WASD (or the left stick).
credits.title: Credits
credits.odbl: Parts of the map and road markings are derived from OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).
credits.fictional: Shops, brands, vehicles and train designs in the game are fictional.
help.title: Controls
help.mouseLock: Click the view to look around with the mouse
hud.prompt.landingSearch: Looking for a place to land…
hud.notice.platformMissing: Couldn't find the platform — try {kInteract} again in a moment
hud.notice.pitRescue: You can't go down onto the tracks — back on the platform
hud.notice.bikeCalled: SANPO Cycle bike called — stand next to it and press {kInteract}
hud.notice.carNotReady: Still getting ready — try {kSummon} again in a moment
hud.notice.carNoCurb: No curb space within 40 m — go to a main-road sidewalk and press {kSummon}
hud.notice.carCalled: Share car called ({dist} m) — press {kInteract} at the driver's door (right, curb side)
hud.notice.ranRed: You crossed the stop line on red — just a reminder (no penalty). Stop before the line next time
hud.notice.exitMoving: Stop first, then press {kInteract} to get off
hud.notice.exitBlocked: No room to get off (wall or step) — move a little, stop, then press {kInteract}
hud.landing.not-ready: Still getting ready — try {kLand} again in a moment
hud.landing.no-ground: No ground below (too high or still loading) — fly lower and press {kLand}
hud.landing.building: Can't land inside or on top of buildings — press {kLand} over a street or plaza
hud.landing.track: Can't land on tracks or platform edges — press {kLand} mid-platform or over a sidewalk
hud.landing.road: Can't land in the middle of the road — press {kLand} over a sidewalk
hud.landing.blocked: Something is in the way or overhead — move aside and press {kLand}
hud.landing.steep: Too steep — press {kLand} over a flat spot
hud.drive.wrongWay: Wrong way — Japan drives on the left
map.title: Map
map.lockedNote: You can only fast-travel to places you have visited.
map.missing: This world has no map data
map.controls: WASD pan · Q/E zoom · drag & wheel · Enter on a place to travel
map.controlsPad: Right stick pan · LT/RT zoom · Ⓐ travel · Ⓑ close
map.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · 3D都市モデル: 国土交通省 PLATEAU · 国土地理院 · 地名: e-Stat
log.title: Field guide
log.unknownHint: Not found yet. It shows as a grey dot on the map — get close and linger for a moment.
log.noPhotos: Photos you take in photo mode (P) gather here.
photo.title: Photo mode
photo.controls: WASD · E/Q move the camera · drag to look · right-click to focus · Esc to exit
photo.controlsPad: Left stick move · right stick look · LB/RB up/down · Ⓐ shutter · Ⓑ exit
photo.apertureHint: Lower numbers blur the background more
photo.focusHint: Right-click the view to focus on that point
photo.savedPoi: Saved ({w}×{h}) — added to “{name}” in the field guide
photo.notice.walkOnly: Photo mode works while walking or flying — get off first, then press P again
save.hint: Move your landmarks, photos, fast-travel list and settings as a file (autosave every 60 s).
save.imported: Imported — applied to the field guide, map and settings
save.invalid: This file isn't a Tokyo Sanpo save, or it is damaged
